name: Nikki Vilella
reason: Too thin to build a proper page: she has no website or YouTube channel of her own, her Commune classes are membership-only with no course page, and her Kula Yoga Project trainings and retreats sit on a Cloudflare-protected booking site that could not be checked, leaving only two podcast interviews. A published address (nikki@kulayoga.com, kulayoga.com/faqs) does exist; she co-directs Kula with Schuyler Grant (rank 1), so a later Kula Yoga Project listing could cover her.
